findings.obs_text: God is named as the one who gives or withholds regard: the Lord to Cain in Gen 4:5, the Almighty to the empty cry in Job 35:13, God to the wise in their own conceit in Job 37:24, the Lord to man in Psa 144:3, the Lord to the exiles in Jer 24:5, and the Lord who will regard his people no more in Lam 4:16.
findings.grounds: nor does the Almighty regard it

findings.obs_text: God is named as the one asked to regard or not to regard: not the stubbornness of the people for the sake of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob in Deu 9:27, the prayer of his servant in 2Ch 6:19, the vine in Psa 80:14.
findings.grounds: have regard to the prayer of your servant

findings.obs_text: In Job 1:8 and Job 2:3 the Lord names Job as the one to be considered and puts the question to the one he speaks to: the considering is asked of another, and Job, God's servant, is its object.
findings.grounds: Have you considered my servant Job

findings.obs_text: In Psa 28:5 and Isa 5:12 the Lord is named as the one whose works and deeds people do not regard.
findings.grounds: they do not regard the deeds of the Lord

findings.obs_text: The ones who consider are named in the accounts of faith and of a decision: Sarah who counts the promiser faithful in Heb 11:11, God counted able in Heb 11:19, the reproach of Christ in Heb 11:26, Sarah's womb in Rom 4:19, and in Mat 1:20 Joseph, son of David, considering while an angel of the Lord comes.
findings.grounds: since she considered him faithful who had promised

findings.obs_text: People are named as those regarded or counted as something: Nabal in 1Sa 25:25, a brother in 2Th 3:15 and 1Pe 5:12, servants of Christ in 1Cor 4:1, Christ known by the flesh in 2Cor 5:16, masters in 1Ti 6:1, rulers named by Jesus in Mar 10:42, the potter in Isa 29:16 and Lam 4:2, man in Isa 33:8, the men in Exo 5:9, the treasurers in Neh 13:13, and Solomon whose silver counts for nothing in 1Ki 10:21 and 2Ch 9:20.
findings.grounds: a faithful brother as I regard him

findings.obs_text: Where the word is a weight, a link or regard for a king, the persons named are the doers around it: the man with the ring in Gen 24:22, the priests before whom the gifts are weighed in Ezr 8:29, the son of man in Eze 5:1, Samson in Judg 15:3, man and God in Ecc 3:18, Elisha, the Lord and Jehoshaphat in 2Ki 3:14, the priests in 2Ch 5:11.
findings.grounds: As the Lord of hosts lives
